mapper.sql:
from (SELECT wpc.* FROM WF_PROCESS_CLASSIFY wpc , ACT_RE_PROCDEF arp
,ACT_HI_PROCINST ahp
,ACT_HI_TASKINST aht
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT htk.PROC_INST_ID_,
htk.TASK_DEF_KEY_,
MAX( htk.END_TIME_ ) AS END_TIME_ FROM act_hi_taskinst htk
htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'delete' AND htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'reback' AND htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'TansunBackDelete'
AND htk.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId}
GROUP BY
htk.TASK_DEF_KEY_,
htk.PROC_INST_ID_ ORDER BY htk.PROC_INST_ID_) singleHi ON aht.PROC_INST_ID_ = singleHi.PROC_INST_ID_ AND aht.END_TIME_ = singleHi.END_TIME_
aht.DELETE_REASON_ != 'delete' AND aht.DELETE_REASON_ != 'reback' AND aht.DELETE_REASON_ != 'TansunBackDelete' AND wpc.id = arp.CATEGORY_ AND arp.ID_ = aht.PROC_DEF_ID_
AND aht.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId}
AND aht.DELETE_REASON_ != #{isTerminateProcess}
AND wpc.code = #{code}
AND ahp.proc_inst_id_ = aht.proc_inst_id_ AND ahp.END_TIME_ is not null
AND ahp.proc_inst_id_ = aht.proc_inst_id_ AND ahp.END_TIME_ is null
AND aht.START_TIME_ <= to_timestamp(#{createTimeBefore}||'.999','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:ss.ff3')
AND aht.START_TIME_ >= to_timestamp(#{createTimeAfter}||'.999','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:ss.ff3')
AND aht.START_TIME_ <= #{createTimeBefore}
AND aht.START_TIME_ >= #{createTimeAfter}
AND aht.END_TIME_ is not null
) RES GROUP BY RES.id, RES.parent_id,
to_char(RES.parent_ids),
RES.parent_ids,
RES.name, RES.sort, RES.code, RES.type, RES.USEABLE, RES.create_by, RES.create_date, RES.update_by, RES.update_date, RES.remarks, RES.del_flag
